## 1. Define the experiment and research question

The Upworthy Research Archive is an open dataset of thousands of A/B tests of headlines conducted by Upworthy from January 2013 to April 2015. I transform this dataset into rows where each row represents a comparison between a single pair of A and B variants. The probability that variant A is greater than B is calculated using the click rate.
